rules.description: Runs every official non-attachable SUPPORT card through MatchEffectService.applySupportEffect on a stable board and fails on unsupported effect types. This is broad smoke coverage, not per-card rules proof.

Runs every official OSHI skill row through MatchEffectService.applySupportEffect on a stable board and fails on unsupported effect types. This covers skill parser/engine compatibility, not full timing legality.
Plays every official attachable SUPPORT card, including Mascot, Tool, and Fan, from hand through MatchActionService.playSupport and verifies the card attaches to a Holomem.

Runs every official MEMBER card through the normal MatchActionService.attackArt path using its primary damage art on a stable board. This covers primary art attack compatibility, not every alternate art row.
Runs every official MEMBER card with Gift text through MatchEffectService.applyStoredGiftTriggeredEffect to smoke-test Gift parser/executor compatibility.
